say:1:1130959001:1.text: Haha, that's an interesting way to look at it. In a sense, we are indeed after treasure.
say:1:1130959001:1.source_cn: 哈哈，这说法有意思。从某种意义上讲，我们的确是来寻宝的。

say:2:1130959002:1.text: But a different type of treasure than most are seeking. Uncovering the mysteries of ages past—that's what we're after!
say:2:1130959002:1.source_cn: 不过我们想找的宝藏和其他人不一样。那些神秘又迷人的失落...

say:3:1130959003:1.text: I really hope we uncover something this time... something worth drafting a thesis on the Dusk Lord!
say:3:1130959003:1.source_cn: 真希望这次能找到点什么，最好能让我们完成一篇关于残阳神...
